prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one professional editorial photograph for the narrow glazed panel of a door on a public-health researcher's website. Portrait aspect ratio 2:3. The subject must clearly convey knowledge transfer AND implementation, rather than an anonymous audience or an office desk. Bright professional workshop: a large, clean upright planning board dominates the central composition. Its upper part contains a large research chart/report; a strong simple arrow leads to several large organised action cards and a clearly visible practical checklist with green check marks below. A pair of workshop participants' hands are visible at the lower edge, one pointing to the research results and one placing an action card on the board, translating findings into a concrete plan. Crop out their faces and bodies. A real paper research report at the base provides a natural tangible foreground. Photograph plausible physical paper and whiteboard materials, realistic hands, natural daylight, white and pale blue environment, dark blue diagrams and muted green progress marks. Crisp and bright enough to be readable at a tiny 100 by 170 pixel thumbnail: a few large meaningful shapes, not dozens of tiny notes; all important content inside the central 80 percent of the frame. Natural photography, not a futuristic interface, not a flat infographic, not plastic 3D icon art. No readable words, letters, numbers, brand logos, watermarks, mortarboards, graduation hats, outdoor scenery, rocks, paths, audience crowds, glowing networks. Output only the portrait photograph, no door frame, no composite sheet.
formatLivraison: JPEG 480 × 720, optimisation de taille sans changement de composition

prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one professional editorial photograph illustrating a PROFESSIONAL CAREER PATH for the narrow glazed panel of a door on a researcher's personal professional website. Portrait aspect ratio 2:3. Make the career chronology immediately recognisable, even when reduced to 100 by 170 pixels. A carefully arranged professional career portfolio: a large, elegant paper CV in the foreground next to an upright physical chronology board. On the board a single vertical line connects FOUR large rectangular milestone cards in ascending chronological order, marked only with the exact years '2016', '2020', '2024', '2025'. The cards look like archived professional documents with restrained lines and small realistic paper details, not generic computer UI tiles. The CV carries only the prominent heading 'CV', with structured sections suggested by tidy neutral lines; no face or portrait on it. The composition shows successive stages of a professional and academic career through a physical dossier and chronology, not a literal hiking or travel route. Natural bright daylight, ivory paper, navy line and understated brass paper clips, pale neutral background, believable physical paper texture and subtle shadows. Keep the CV and the timeline tightly framed and centred so both remain clear within the portrait crop; minimise background emptiness. Serious professional photography, not cartoon, not a futuristic glowing illustration, not a diploma ceremony. NO rocks, cliffs, outdoor paths, mountains, walking shoes, compass, graduation caps, mortarboards, hats, faces, people, medals, logos, watermarks, invented qualifications, extra readable text. Only 'CV' and the four exact years above may be readable. Output only the portrait photograph, no door frame or collage sheet.
formatLivraison: JPEG 480 × 720, optimisation de taille sans changement de composition
